reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: 週に何回かつかっております。角質ケアをしてくれるみたいですが、しげきはつよくないです
reviews.zh: 一個禮拜用幾次。睇落好似有助護理角質，但刺激就唔算強。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: Repurchase! They’re very easy to use and effective. I like to use them before make up all over the face and use the textured side of the pad to buff the sides of my nose and chin to prevent caking and separation.
reviews.zh: 會回購！佢哋好用又有效。我鍾意喺化妝前用佢哋抹勻全面，再用有紋理嘅嗰面輕擦鼻翼同下巴位，避免浮粉同斑駁。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text:
My skin absolutely loves these toner pads, the texture on my face is going way and my face feels smoother and soft but also hydrated. 
I also have the regular toner and I really like them. I’m hoping and it looks like it’ll help with my hyper pigmentation.
reviews.zh:
我塊面超愛呢啲爽膚水棉片，用咗之後面上去角質嘅粗糙感覺消失咗，塊面摸落更滑更柔軟，而且有水潤感。
我亦有返普通裝嘅爽膚水，我都好鍾意用。希望睇落都見到佢對我嘅色斑有幫助。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: I love this product for its effectiveness in exfoliation. I use this twice a week in the evening, and my skin always turns out super glowy afterwards. Definitely a must in my skin routine.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢件產品嘅去角質功效。我一星期用兩次，喺晚上用，用完之後皮膚總係超有水光感。絕對係我護膚程序中嘅必備。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: For redness, these are better than the Mediheal Teatree ones! When my face was extremely red, burning, and irritated, these calmed my skin down immediately. It initially has a soothing, almost numbing effect. The pictures were taken within two hours of each other, and although it took a few rounds, look at the difference! I was so surprised, and since then these have been my go-to for redness. On days when I don't need to leave them on, I like to swipe them over my face to remove all my dead skin and oils. There's also a minty smell, which I personally like. These are my favorite toner pads, and would recommend them to anyone!
reviews.zh: 針對泛紅，呢啲比 Mediheal 茶樹嗰款更好用！當我塊面極度泛紅、灼熱又受刺激嘅時候，佢即時令皮膚冷靜落嚟。初始有一種舒緩、幾乎麻醉嘅感覺。兩張相係兩個鐘頭內影嘅，雖然用咗幾次先見效，但睇下個分別！我好驚喜，自此之後佢就係我處理泛紅嘅首選。喺啲唔需要敷住嘅日子，我鍾意用嚟輕抹塊面，帶走死皮同油脂。仲有薄荷味，我自己幾鍾意。呢款係我最愛嘅爽膚水棉片，推薦畀任何人！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: Minty scent, soothing and calming, good for reducing redness! Also love that it is thin so it adheres to skin very well, and it comes with cute pincers which I find very useful in separating the pads!
reviews.zh: 薄荷香味，舒緩又鎮靜，減少泛紅效果好！而且薄薄一片好貼面，仲附送可愛嘅鉗子，用嚟分開棉片非常好用！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: It was fine, made my skim texture smoother and hydrated, but i was often getting red on the nose aera after using it. The smell was minty/eucalyptus. The pads were smooth and not irritating.
reviews.zh: 整體OK，令到皮膚質地變滑又保濕，但用完之後成日鼻位泛紅。味道係薄荷／桉樹味。棉片質地滑，唔刺激。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle True Cica Clear Pad 70ea
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! I have been using it nonstop for a month, twice a day and it really helps improve my skin. Reduce redness, provide enough moisturizer for my skin. It nearly runs out and I already have another in my shopping bag waiting for purchase
reviews.zh: 極度推薦！！！我連續用咗一個月，每日兩次，真係幫到我改善膚質。減少泛紅，為肌膚提供足夠保濕。差唔多用完，購物車已經有後補喺度等緊落單
